mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS rises, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the effective federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 0.5%, it signals the start of a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates for equities and reduces risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS > 0.5 remains positive or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in less than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a stagflationary environment where monetary tightening coincides with economic weakness, causing equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression has a non-significant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes, a combination of strong housing starts (HOUST) and robust GDP growth (GDPC1) signals sustained economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, the joint signal of rising HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing and industrial activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO rises, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 800,000 units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector, which reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST < 800.0 remains positive or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in less than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 235.0), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement aggressive monetary tightening, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 235.0 remains positive or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in less than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 235.0 indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to a delayed monetary policy response and increased market volatility, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Over any 3-year rolling window, the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 235.0 fails to be negative (i.e., IC >= 0) in more than 30% of the windows.
